allDirections.name: Dispatch Board
allDirections.summary: A shared inbox that reads like an air-traffic control strip — every ticket is a moveable card on a board, with statuses and agents as visual tags. Built for teams that triage fast and hate clutter.
allDirections.typographyVoice: Space Grotesk display with Onest body; tight tracking, crisp terminals.
signatureMoves: Ticket IDs as oversized tabular numerals (700 weight) with a hairline underline in the accent; always left-aligned.
Status column headers that light up with a 2px left rail in accent when hovered.
Priority labels rendered as bordered chips with a single accent tick — high priority gets a filled square dot.
Keyboard shortcut hints as small black text on gray squares, like keycaps, with no rounding.
Empty state shows a ghosted queue with dashed border lines and a single blinking cursor block.

allDirections.name: Meridian Lounge
allDirections.summary: A calmer, warmer support inbox that groups conversations into soft cards you can drag into assignee lanes. Feels like a well-run front desk — personal, responsive, human.
allDirections.typographyVoice: Sora display with DM Sans body; rounded but professional, humanist warmth.
signatureMoves: Assignee lanes as horizontal columns where cards 'squish' and spring into place when reordered (CSS spring animation).
Response timer as a small circular progress ring next to the avatar — orange to red as deadline nears.
Priority tags as colored dot + text, with the dot having a soft bokeh glow (solid fill, no gradient).
Conversation previews indent with a 4px rounded left border that matches the priority color.
New message indicator as a small bouncing arrow in the accent, pointing to the card.

allDirections.name: Inkwell Archive
allDirections.summary: A stately, editorial support inbox that feels like sorting rare letters. Every conversation is a document, with type at the center and tonal paper washes behind priorities.
allDirections.typographyVoice: Bricolage Grotesque display with Outfit body; high contrast, editorial elegance.
signatureMoves: Conversation list as a 'letter index' — each row is a mini envelope with a stamp-sized avatar and a date in oversized light numerals.
Assignment state shown as a wax-seal-style dot that 'melts' from accent to muted when resolved (using a scale/fade, no gradient).
Response timer is a thin vertical bar on the right edge of the card, like a pulse line; it extends downward as time runs out.
Priority labels as full-pill chips with a subtle inner shadow (solid fill, no gradient) and letter-spaced uppercase text.
Empty state uses a huge centered typographic 'INBOX ZERO' in the display font, with a single accent underline and a small sub-caption.
